WITH Party_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(PartySK),0) RN FROM DW.DimParty
)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM Party_SK) AS PartySK
,PartyId AS PartyID
,PartyName AS PartyName
,PartyTypeId AS PartyType
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,SourceCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Party
